notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.content:
- Removed upgrade slots from the shop.
- Light ship speed increased, and all ships get +1 max speed.
- Missiles (Level 5): now have a 10% chance to fire a special rocket with each shot, instead of always being Hellfire.
- Plasma saw duration reduced by 50%.
- Using a credit now lets you keep all upgrades.
- High score names are no longer trimmed.
- Fixed screen movement issue at 120+ FPS.
- Added a per-level limit on “P” pickups (don’t worry—it’s still generous).
- In Warp Battles, a “C” pickup is now added when green orbs are set to option 3.
- Slightly reduced magma damage.
- Slightly increased plasma damage.

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.content:
MAIN MENU
- Build number is now displayed on the main menu.
- Player name is highlighted on the scoreboard for easier tracking.
- Scoreboard navigation improved: you can now jump directly between the Rookie list and Global list using left/right navigation.
- Manual screen display time has been extended.
- Added a third option for the green orb in graphic settings: a round green orb with a C inside.

GAMEPLAY
- Players now start with 1 credit, which can be used at any time upon death.
- The ARMOURY letters now display as a full sequence (A, R, M...) instead of showing only A.

notes.title: This is it! We made it - we all made it!
notes.content:
[p]Tomorrow marks the release of a game we’ve been building for over a year — a journey that would never have been possible without you.[/p][p align="start"]From the very first Kickstarter pledge to the countless messages of encouragement, you’ve given us not just funding, but belief. You believed in our vision when it was nothing more than sketches, code, and late-night dreams. You’ve helped turn that into something real — something we can now share with the world.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]This game is as much yours as it is ours. Every pixel, every sound effect carries a piece of your support. We hope playing it feels like being part of the adventure you helped create.[/p][p align="start"]And this is just the beginning. There’s so much more to come — updates, surprises, and goodies that we can’t wait to share with you.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]From the bottom of our hearts — thank you for making this possible.
Here’s to launch day, and to the worlds we’ll keep building together.[/p][p]
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=70tpJ10iSRg&ab_channel=ProjectXLightYears"][/dynamiclink]
[/p]

notes.title: Launch Day Approaches — Are You Ready?
notes.content:
[p]The time has come! 

We are thrilled to announce that our game will be released on [b]Friday, the 15th[/b]. After a year of hard work, hundreds of hours of testing, and countless balance tweaks, we are finally ready to share it with you.[/p][p]This is a truly special moment for me — one I have been waiting for my entire life — and I sincerely hope it brings you as much joy as it has brought us during its creation.[/p][p]The release is just the beginning. We will continue to support the game with further balance updates, tweaks, and additional content. A DLC is already in our plans. Furthermore, community-created content from our backers, such as new power-ups and enemy waves, will be added post-launch as smaller updates.[/p][p]

MK Games team[/p]

notes.title: Game Update - A Blast from the Past!
notes.content:
Chris Brimble is back! After 32 years, the legendary voice returns with brand-new voice work, bringing the game back to its roots!

Enhanced Sound Settings – Fine-tune your experience with expanded controls for music, SFX, and speech.

Retro Audio Mode – Enjoy classic-style sounds and voices for the ultimate nostalgia trip.

New In-Game Pause Menu – Adjust sound settings on the fly without leaving the action.

More Audio Goodies – We've added extra sound samples for a richer experience.

Shoot Down Enemy Missiles! Now you can destroy incoming threats with regular bullets for more dynamic gameplay.

Retro Vibes Amped Up – Level transitions now pack even more of that authentic old-school charm.

Jump in and feel the classic energy like never before!

notes.title: Thank You!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has helped Project X: Light Years meet its initial funding goal. Now that we’ve passed this landmark, I’m pleased to confirm some big news… 

Original Project X composer Allister Brimble has kindly agreed to create a new title theme for Project X: Light Years!

Allister’s music is an important and iconic element of the original Project X, so I’m thrilled to have him on board. 

Don’t forget that if we reach the £10,000 funding goal then Allister will create a full and original soundtrack for the whole game. There’s still time left to back the project and take advantage of the backer rewards, so please do help us out and spread the word. If you know a Project X or Amiga fan, please tell them about Light Years and let’s help make a new game that pleases the fans!

notes.title: Partnership with Team17, an official entry in the Project X series!
notes.content:
In partnership with Team17, an official entry in the Project X series.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101964/993dc5bc1f46cf05a9392f3a0826c0271ffe2708.jpg[/img]


This is a massive opportunity, and I’m honoured to have their blessing to independently release the game. However, to meet their high expectations of Project X fans and bring this project to its full potential, I need your help!


Game development is a complex process, and we are at a critical stage. To keep the momentum going and ensure we deliver a game worthy of the Team17 legacy, I’m seeking funding support. 

Every contribution will help us push the game to new heights— whether it's refining gameplay, enhancing visuals, or adding more content.


If you believe in this project and want to be part of something special, please consider supporting us on this journey. With your help, we can make this game the best it can be!


Thank you all for your continued encouragement—let’s make this dream a reality together!
